auth.label: Authenticate with Spotify
auth.description: This button will redirect you to Spotify to authenticate.

auth_dev.label: Authenticate Developer Session
auth_dev.description: Authenticate with your custom Client ID.

clear_auth_dev.label: Clear Developer Authentication
clear_auth_dev.description: Clear the developer session authentication and client ID.

sync_podcast_progress.label: Sync Podcast Progress from Spotify
sync_podcast_progress.description: Automatically sync episode played status from Spotify to Music Assistant. Episodes marked as played in Spotify will be marked as played in MA. Only enable this if you use both the Spotify app and Music Assistant for podcast playback.

sync_audiobook_progress.label: Sync Audiobook Progress from Spotify
sync_audiobook_progress.description: Automatically sync audiobook progress from Spotify to Music Assistant. Progress from Spotify app will sync to MA when audiobooks are accessed. Only enable this if you use both the Spotify app and Music Assistant for audiobook playback.

playback_auth_method.label: How do you want to allow playback?

use_developer_key.label: Use my own Spotify developer key (advanced, optional)

authenticate.title: Connect your Spotify account
authenticate.description: A browser window will open so you can sign in to Spotify and authorize Music Assistant. Come back here once you're done.

developer.title: Use your own Spotify developer key
developer.description:
1. Open the [Spotify Developer Dashboard](https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard) and create an app.

2. Register this address as a redirect URI for that app:
`{0}`

3. Copy the app's Client ID and paste it below.

Leave the field empty to keep using the shared key.

authenticate_dev.title: Authorize your Spotify app
authenticate_dev.description: A browser window will open to authorize Music Assistant against your own Spotify app.

playback_auth.title: Allow Music Assistant to play Spotify audio
playback_auth.description:
Playing audio needs a separate one-time approval from Spotify, on top of the sign-in you just completed.

**Use the Spotify app (recommended)** - pick this if you have Spotify on a phone, tablet or computer on the same network as Music Assistant. It takes a few taps and there is nothing to copy or paste.

**Use a web browser instead** - pick this if Music Assistant will not show up in your Spotify app, for example when it runs on another network or VLAN, or in a container without access to your home network. It takes a couple of extra steps.

playback_browser_open.title: Approve playback in your browser
playback_browser_open.description:
Press the button below to open Spotify, sign in if asked, then press Agree.

If your browser runs on the same machine as Music Assistant, this screen continues by itself.

Otherwise your browser lands on a page that fails to load, showing something like "This site can't be reached". That is expected and means it worked. Copy the address of that page, then come back here: this screen switches to a box to paste it into within half a minute.

playback_pairing.title: Select Music Assistant in your Spotify app
playback_pairing.progress_text:
Waiting for you to select Music Assistant in the Spotify app.

1. Open the Spotify app on your phone, tablet or computer.
2. Start playing any song, so the player bar appears at the bottom.
3. Tap the speaker icon in the player bar (Connect to a device).
4. Choose "Music Assistant" from the list of devices.

No audio will play on it. Selecting it only grants permission, and you can switch back to your usual speaker right after. This screen continues by itself once you have done it.

Not seeing it? Make sure the device running Spotify is on the same network as Music Assistant. You can also go back and choose the web browser option.

playback_browser.title: Paste the address you landed on
playback_browser.description:
Your browser could not reach Music Assistant directly, so the last step is manual.

1. Copy the full web address of the page that failed to load, from your browser's address bar.

2. Paste it below and press Next.

The address starts with 127.0.0.1 and contains a one-time code, so paste all of it without editing. If you no longer have that page open, [try again with a new link]({0}).

developer_optin.title: You're all set
developer_optin.description:
Spotify has been added to Music Assistant. Press Finish to start.

Your Spotify library is imported in the background, which takes a while the first time. Playlists, albums and artists keep appearing as the import progresses, so it is normal for them to look empty or incomplete for the first few minutes.

Optionally, you can connect your own Spotify developer key. It makes browsing and searching faster, but it takes a few extra steps to set up. Most people can skip this, and you can always add it later.

errors.refresh_token_invalid: Your Spotify session has expired or been revoked. Please re-authenticate to continue using Spotify.
errors.pairing_not_completed: Music Assistant wasn't selected in the Spotify app in time. Try again, or use the web browser option if Music Assistant doesn't appear in your Spotify app.
errors.playback_code_invalid: That address could not be used. Make sure you copied the complete address of the error page, and note that each attempt can only be used once — start over to get a new link.
errors.playback_auth_required: Spotify needs you to approve audio playback again. Open the Spotify provider settings and run through the setup once more to restore playback.
errors.playback_not_completed: Playback wasn't approved in time. Open the link again and paste the address of the page your browser ends up on.
errors.playback_auth_failed: Approving playback didn't work. Please try again.
errors.librespot_unavailable: Music Assistant has no Spotify playback support for this system, so Spotify audio cannot be played here.
